caption: The drawing depicts a stone archway composed of two thick, vertical columns supporting a broad, rectangular entablature with a protruding cornice at the top. The stonework is rendered in shades of beige and light brown, giving the appearance of weathered limestone. The columns are fluted, with multiple vertical grooves and decorative rings near their bases and halfway up. The center of the archway is characterized by a pointed horseshoe-shaped arch with stepped, angular moldings layering inward toward the opening. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery, and the artist’s name “ROSE CAMPBELL-GIRKE” is written in small, fine letters near the lower right corner.
title: Archway
